reason: The plugin is primarily a usage-monitoring utility for configured LLM providers, designed to show quota and token consumption in the DSH web interface. Evidence shows a theme-aware bottom-right bubble UI, configurable refresh policies, per-provider detail panels, and a model tool to query usage, with network calls to provider billing/usage endpoints as its core function.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，在页面右下角展示已配置模型提供商的实时用量与配额，并提供可配置刷新策略、供应商详情和界面内查询入口。
summaries.en: This DSH web plugin displays configured model providers’ live usage and quota in a bottom-right bubble with configurable refresh behavior, per-provider detail views, and an in-app usage query tool.

capabilities: Fetches provider usage/quota data from external LLM APIs
Reads provider configuration/credentials via host context
Displays live usage summaries and detailed metrics in the DSH web UI
Exposes in-app tool/query interfaces for usage inspection

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a DSH web plugin that shows real-time usage/quota of configured LLM providers in a bottom-right bubble with detailed per-provider metrics on hover.

README lists host JSON routes `/provider-usage/query`, `/provider-usage/config`, and `/provider-usage/activity`, plus auto-discovery and direct calls to provider endpoints like `/v1/usage`, `/auth/key`, `/user/balance`, and billing subscription routes.

Package metadata defines a DSH web plugin bundle/exports for `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`, and injects web client runtime modules, confirming integration with external services and UI rendering.
